hero.filename: USS Cochino (SS-345) leaving Portsmouth, Hampshire (UK), circa in July 1949 (NH 95925).jpg
hero.caption: The U.S. Navy submarine USS Cochino (SS-345) leaving Portsmouth, Hampshire (UK), for the Barents Sea, circa July 1949. Cochino was sunk on 25 August 1949, following a battery explosion while operating off Norway.
hero.alt: The U.S. Navy submarine USS Cochino (SS-345) leaving Portsmouth, Hampshire (UK), for the Barents Sea, circa July 1949. Cochino was sunk on 25 August 1949, following a battery explosion while operating off Norway.
